technical.summary: ACN shows long-term bullish structure with Ichimoku TK cross-up and strong trend confirmation, but overbought conditions (Stoch, StochRSI, Williams %R) and negative MACD histogram create near-term pullback risk; moderate confluence with neutral sector tailwind.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 40 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed small trades across parties 79-98 days ago; neutral market sentiment (AAII 42.6% bullish, Fear/Greed 46) offers neither opportunity nor warning; insufficient news data.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (83.08) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 40 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku TK cross-up with EMA 50/200 bullish alignment and Supertrend confirmation establish long-term uptrend structure despite near-term overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX 83.08 crisis, inverted yield curve recession signal), triple overbought oscillators with negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental support, and price at 52-week highs create asymmetric downside risk with minimal reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term Ichimoku TK cross-up and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment provide structural uptrend confirmation. However, extreme macro stress (VIX 83.08, inverted yield curve) and triple overbought oscillators with negative MACD histogram create asymmetric risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels and recession-signaling yield curve inversion create macro headwinds that could trigger sharp pullback from 52-week highs; earnings in 40 days adds event risk with zero fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical shows overbought near-term despite bullish structure; fundamental shows zero conviction; sentiment neutral; macro severely unfavourable
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position with 15 existing IT sector positions (35% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure; skip entry and monitor for pullback to EMA 20 or Ichimoku cloud support.
